unsung.words: You came back to hear us forget again.
unsung.delivery: On the lifts. Resigned. Fragment budget 1.2 s.

unsung.words: Who will sing its part now?

The second mask breaks: the last mask tries to finish a sentence by itself, the only line in the first person singular. Halting, frightened. Three variants, one per survivor. Starts 1 beat after the crack. Budget 3.2 s.

unsung.words: Another voice falls silent in the song.

unsung.delivery: Gentle, and a real hint: everything lands on the beat. Budget 3.1 s.

unsung.words: Gently, thief, that astrolabe was ours.

unsung.words: You found the silence we never could.
